what_it_does: Designing millimeter-wave power amplifiers (the radio chips in 5G antennas) is painful: engineers manually pick from pre-built templates, then spend weeks tweaking transistor sizes and matching networks through trial-and-error simulation. This work automates the entire pipeline using AI. It uses reinforcement learning (a learning approach that learns by trial) to explore new circuit topologies automatically, inverse EM synthesis to calculate passive matching networks, and automatic layout generation. The result: circuits designed and fabricated in silicon without any manual template selection or iterative guesswork.
